vision.name: Namekian Right Throw
vision.text:
ENDURANCE 2.
[Attack] Physical attack.
You may shuffle a Dragon Ball you control back into its owner's Life Deck. If you do and your MP has 2 or less Traits, raise your anger 2.
DAMAGE: AT + 3 stages.
